newsitem.title: USA: National Service in talks to sell some units.
newsitem.headline: National Service in talks to sell some units.

text.p: National Service Industries Inc said Tuesday it is in discussions with several potential buyers for the possible sale of some units not fitting the company's strategic plan.
But the discussions are not concluded and no decisions have been reached, said James Balloun, chief executive officer of the company.
National Service, with fiscal year 1996 sales of $2.0 billion, has four business segments -- lighting equipment, textile rental, specialty chemicals and envelopes.
The company also said it was continuing its strategic review of certain components of its textile rental segment, National Linen Service.

The previously announced review was designed to evaluate individual operating units in terms of revenue quality, sales growth potential, asset utilization, expense control and customer retention, the company said.
